title: G-equivariant sheaves and cosheaves
body_html:
$G$-equivariant sheaves and cosheaves

Assume $G$ acts cellularly on $X$ (see Locally finite regular CW complex with cellular G-action).

Definition. A $G$-equivariant $\mathscr{C}$-valued sheaf on $X$ is a pair $(V,a)$ where $V$ is a sheaf on $X$ and $a$ assigns to each $g \in G$ a morphism $a(g) \in \Hom(V, g^*V)$ satisfying $a(gh) = (h^* a(g)) \circ a(h)$, with $g^*V$ obtained by post-composing $V$ with $g : ]X[ \to ]X[$.

Cellular form. Equivalently, a $G$-equivariant sheaf is a collection

  • $V_F$, one object of $\mathscr{C}$ for each cell $F \in [\![X]\!]$;
  • a restriction $r^V_{E,F} : V_E \to V_F$ for each $E \preceq F$;
  • an isomorphism $a^V_{g,F} : V_F \to V_{gF}$ for each $g \in G$, $F \in [\![X]\!]$,

subject to four compatibilities:

  • $r^V_{E,E} = \id_{V_E}$;
  • $r^V_{E,F} \circ r^V_{D,E} = r^V_{D,F}$ for $D \preceq E \preceq F$;
  • $a^V_{g,hF} \circ a^V_{h,F} = a^V_{gh,F}$;
  • $a^V_{g,F} \circ r^V_{E,F} = r^V_{gE,gF} \circ a^V_{g,E}$ (equivariance of restrictions).

A $G$-equivariant cosheaf has the analogous data with restriction directions reversed.

Notation. We write $\Sh_G(X,R)$ (resp.\ $\Cosh_G(X,R)$) for $G$-equivariant $R$-modules; for the trivial group we recover $\Sh(X,R) = \Sh_{\{e\}}(X,R)$.

Lean formalization

Naming convention: functor form (Sheaf, Cosheaf) vs object form (Sheaf', Cosheaf')

Two equivalent presentations of the underlying (non-equivariant) (co)sheaf exist in the paper, and the Lean library encodes both under distinct names:

  • Sheaf X C, Cosheaf X C (no prime) — functor form. Literal X ⥤ C and Xᵒᵖ ⥤ C, introduced as abbrevs. All of Mathlib's CategoryTheory.Functor API applies directly with no wrapping. This is the canonical form used throughout the library — GEquivSheaf, GEquivCosheaf, and the reduction chain (Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD) all sit on top of it.

  • Sheaf' X C, Cosheaf' X C (with prime) — object form. Sheaf7 §2.2's classical $(V, r)$-pair form as a structure with fields obj : X → C and (co)restriction morphisms map : E ≤ E' → … plus functoriality axioms. Kept as a concrete surface for constructions that read more clearly with explicit field access than with functor destructuring.

The two forms are provably equivalent, at increasing strength:

  • Type-level bijection Sheaf.equivPrimed : Sheaf X C ≃ Sheaf' X C (and cosheaf dual), with left_inv/right_inv closed by Sheaf.ofObject_toObject / Sheaf.toObject_ofObject (proved by cases-then-rfl — round-trip agrees on the nose).
  • Categorical equivalence Sheaf.equivPrimedEquiv : Sheaf X C ≌ Sheaf' X C (and cosheaf dual), where Sheaf' X C is promoted to a category via an explicit Sheaf'.Hom structure (an app-component family with a naturality square against map), and the unit/counit NatIsos reduce to eqToIso on the round-trip lemmas above.

Downstream code should PREFER the no-prime (functor) form — it composes with Mathlib's functor-category API for free; the primed form exists to bridge the paper's presentation for readers whose mental model is object-oriented. Any theorem stated for one form transports to the other along the categorical equivalence.

Equivariance data

The bundled structures GEquivSheaf' / GEquivCosheaf' inline the pointwise action data as fields (see the auto-extracted signatures in the Lean declarations section for exact types):

act : ∀ (g : G) (E : X), obj E ≅ obj (g • E)

as a family of isomorphisms (matching the paper's convention "$g_* : V_E \xrightarrow{\sim} V_{gE}$"), together with three axioms — act_map (naturality with (co)sheaf restrictions), act_one (identity of $G$ acts as $\mathbf 1$ modulo eqToHom for $1 \cdot E = E$), and act_mul (multiplicativity modulo eqToHom for $(g\cdot h)\cdot E = g\cdot(h\cdot E)$).

Why Iso and not just a morphism. For a Group G invertibility of act g follows abstractly, but packaging as Iso from the start gives downstream code direct access to .inv, avoiding rewrite-motive typechecking failures on rw [inv_one] when g⁻¹ appears in an eqToHom target type. The derived lemma GEquivCosheaf'.act_one_inv records that (act 1 E).inv equals the eqToHom bridging W_{1 \cdot E} = W_E.

For §2.7 (Prop 2.7.2) we need $\Cosh_G(X, C)$ as a category (not just a predicate on individual cosheaves): the file GEquivCosheaf.lean supplies the bundled type GEquivCosheaf' G X C symmetric to GEquivSheaf' (both extend the primed base type — Sheaf' or Cosheaf' — and inline the pointwise-iso equivariance fields act, act_map, act_one, act_mul). A Category instance is provided whose morphisms are structure homs (Cosheaf'.Hom component + act_comm equivariance-commuting axiom). See The transporter categories ]X/G[ and [X/G] for the ]X/G[-side of the same story.

lean_refs.signature: abbrev Sheaf (C : Type*) [Category C] : Type _ := X ⥤ C

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Cosheaf

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Sheaf'
lean_refs.signature:
structure Sheaf' (C : Type*) [Category C] where
  /-- Object at each cell. -/
  obj : X → C
  /-- Restriction morphism for a face relation. -/
  map : ∀ {E E' : X}, E ≤ E' → (obj E ⟶ obj E')
  /-- Restriction along the identity face is the identity morphism. -/
  map_id : ∀ E, map (le_refl E) = 𝟙 (obj E) := by aesop_cat
  /-- Restriction is compatible with composition of face relations. -/
  map_comp : ∀ {E E' E'' : X} (h : E ≤ E') (h' : E' ≤ E''),
    map (le_trans h h') = map h ≫ map h' := by aesop_cat

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Cosheaf'
lean_refs.signature:
structure Cosheaf' (C : Type*) [Category C] where
  /-- Object at each cell. -/
  obj : X → C
  /-- Corestriction morphism for a face relation (note the reversed
  arrow direction compared to `Sheaf'`). -/
  map : ∀ {E E' : X}, E ≤ E' → (obj E' ⟶ obj E)
  /-- Corestriction along the identity face is the identity morphism. -/
  map_id : ∀ E, map (le_refl E) = 𝟙 (obj E) := by aesop_cat
  /-- Corestriction is compatible with composition of face relations. -/
  map_comp : ∀ {E E' E'' : X} (h : E ≤ E') (h' : E' ≤ E''),
    map (le_trans h h') = map h' ≫ map h := by aesop_cat

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Sheaf.toObject
lean_refs.signature:
def toObject {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Sheaf X C) : Sheaf' X C where
  obj := F.obj
  map h := F.map (homOfLE h)
  map_id E := F.map_id E
  map_comp _ _ := F.map_comp _ _

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Sheaf.ofObject
lean_refs.signature:
def ofObject {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Sheaf' X C) : Sheaf X C where
  obj := F.obj
  map {_ _} h := F.map (leOfHom h)
  map_id := F.map_id
  map_comp _ _ := F.map_comp _ _

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Cosheaf.toObject
lean_refs.signature:
def toObject {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Cosheaf X C) : Cosheaf' X C where
  obj E := F.obj (op E)
  map h := F.map (homOfLE h).op
  map_id E := F.map_id (op E)
  map_comp _ _ := F.map_comp _ _

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Cosheaf.ofObject
lean_refs.signature:
def ofObject {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : Cosheaf' X C) : Cosheaf X C where
  obj E := F.obj E.unop
  map {_ _} h := F.map (leOfHom h.unop)
  map_id _ := F.map_id _
  map_comp _ _ := F.map_comp _ _

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Sheaf.equivPrimedEquiv
lean_refs.signature:
def equivPrimedEquiv {C : Type*} [Category C] : Sheaf X C ≌ Sheaf' X C where
  functor := toObjectFunctor
  inverse := ofObjectFunctor
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents (fun F => eqToIso (ofObject_toObject F).symm)
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents (fun F => eqToIso (toObject_ofObject F))

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivCosheaf'.act_one_inv
lean_refs.signature:
theorem act_one_inv (W : GEquivCosheaf' G X C) (E : X) :
    (W.act (1 : G) E).inv =
      eqToHom (show W.obj ((1 : G) • E) = W.obj E by rw [one_smul])

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivCosheaf'
lean_refs.signature:
structure GEquivCosheaf' (C : Type*) [Category C] extends Cosheaf' X C where
  /-- Stalk-level action of `g` at `E` as an iso. -/
  act : ∀ (g : G) (E : X), obj E ≅ obj (g • E)
  /-- Naturality against cosheaf **corestriction** (map direction is
  `E ≤ E' → obj E' ⟶ obj E`).  Swap of sides compared to `GEquivSheaf'`. -/
  act_map : ∀ (g : G) {E E' : X} (h : E ≤ E'),
    map h ≫ (act g E).hom = (act g E').hom ≫ map (GCellComplex.smul_le g h)
  /-- Identity: `act 1 E = 𝟙`, modulo `eqToHom` for `1 • E = E`. -/
  act_one : ∀ E : X,
    (act 1 E).hom ≫ eqToHom (show obj ((1 : G) • E) = obj E by rw [one_smul]) =
      𝟙 (obj E)
  /-- Multiplicativity. -/
  act_mul : ∀ (g h : G) (E : X),
    (act (g * h) E).hom ≫
        eqToHom (show obj ((g * h) • E) = obj (g • h • E) by rw [mul_smul]) =
      (act h E).hom ≫ (act g (h • E)).hom

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivCosheaf'.category
lean_refs.signature:
instance category : Category (GEquivCosheaf' G X C) where
  Hom F F' := Hom F F'
  id F := Hom.id F
  comp α β := Hom.comp α β
  id_comp α := by
    cases α with
    | mk toHom _ =>
      show Hom.comp (Hom.id _) ⟨toHom, _⟩ = ⟨toHom, _⟩
      simp [Hom.comp, Hom.id]
  comp_id α := by
    cases α with
    | mk toHom _ =>
      show Hom.comp ⟨toHom, _⟩ (Hom.id _) = ⟨toHom, _⟩
      simp [Hom.comp, Hom.id]
  assoc α β γ := by
    show Hom.comp (Hom.comp α β) γ = Hom.comp α (Hom.comp β γ)
    simp [Hom.comp, Category.assoc]

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivSheaf'
lean_refs.signature:
structure GEquivSheaf' (C : Type*) [Category C] extends Sheaf' X C where
  /-- Stalk-level action of `g` at `E` as an iso. -/
  act : ∀ (g : G) (E : X), obj E ≅ obj (g • E)
  /-- Naturality against sheaf restrictions. -/
  act_map : ∀ (g : G) {E E' : X} (h : E ≤ E'),
    (act g E).hom ≫ map (GCellComplex.smul_le g h) =
      map h ≫ (act g E').hom
  /-- Identity: `act 1 E = 𝟙`, modulo `eqToHom` for `1 • E = E`. -/
  act_one : ∀ E : X,
    (act 1 E).hom ≫ eqToHom (show obj ((1 : G) • E) = obj E by rw [one_smul]) =
      𝟙 (obj E)
  /-- Multiplicativity. -/
  act_mul : ∀ (g h : G) (E : X),
    (act (g * h) E).hom ≫
        eqToHom (show obj ((g * h) • E) = obj (g • h • E) by rw [mul_smul]) =
      (act h E).hom ≫ (act g (h • E)).hom

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctorFunctor
lean_refs.signature:
noncomputable def GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctorFunctor :
    GEquivCosheaf' G X C ⥤ (TransporterCat G X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C where
  obj W := TransporterCat.GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctor W
  map {W W'} α :=
    { app := fun E => (GEquivCosheaf'.homNT α).app E.unop.cell
      naturality := by
        intro E E' β
        show (TransporterCat.GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctor W).map β ≫
            (homNT α).app E'.unop.cell =
          (homNT α).app E.unop.cell ≫
            (TransporterCat.GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctor W').map β
        change (W.map β.unop.property ≫
            (W.act β.unop.val E'.unop.cell).inv) ≫ _ =
          _ ≫ (W'.map β.unop.property ≫
            (W'.act β.unop.val E'.unop.cell).inv)
        -- LHS = W.map ≫ (act).inv ≫ (homNT α).app
        -- RHS = (homNT α).app ≫ W'.map ≫ (act).inv
        -- Strategy: use (homNT α).naturality to move .app past W.map on the LHS,
        -- then use homNT_comm to swap past (act).inv.
        have hnat := (homNT α).naturality β.unop.property
        -- hnat: W.map _ ≫ (homNT α).app _ = (homNT α).app _ ≫ W'.map _
        have hcomm := homNT_comm α β.unop.val E'.unop.cell
        -- hcomm: (homNT α).app E ≫ (W'.act g E).hom = (W.act g E).hom ≫ (homNT α).app (g•E)
        have hcomm' : (W.act β.unop.val E'.unop.cell).inv ≫
            (homNT α).app E'.unop.cell =
            (homNT α).app (β.unop.val • E'.unop.cell) ≫
              (W'.act β.unop.val E'.unop.cell).inv := by
          rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← hcomm,
              Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
        -- Now rewrite the LHS: goal is (A ≫ B) ≫ C = D ≫ E ≫ F
        --   A ≫ (B ≫ C) then swap B ≫ C via hcomm'.
        rw [Category.assoc]
        rw [hcomm']
        -- Now LHS: A ≫ (α at (g•E)) ≫ B'
        -- Reassoc and apply hnat.
        rw [← Category.assoc]
        rw [hnat]
        rw [Category.assoc] }
  map_id W := by
    ext E

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.Functor.toGEquivCosheaf'
lean_refs.signature:
noncomputable def toGEquivCosheaf'
    (F : (TransporterCat G X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C) : GEquivCosheaf' G X C where
  toCosheaf' := Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)
  act g E :=
    { hom := F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g E).op
      inv := F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxInv g E).op
      hom_inv_id := by
        rw [← F.map_comp, ← op_comp, toGEquivCosheaf'AuxInv_inv_id, op_id]
        exact F.map_id _
      inv_hom_id := by
        rw [← F.map_comp, ← op_comp, toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom_inv_id, op_id]
        exact F.map_id _ }
  act_map := by
    intro g E F' h
    show (Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)).map h ≫
        F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g E).op =
      F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g F').op ≫
        (Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)).map
          (GCellComplex.smul_le g h)
    show F.map (toTransporterCat.op.map (homOfLE h).op) ≫
        F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g E).op =
      F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g F').op ≫
        F.map (toTransporterCat.op.map (homOfLE (GCellComplex.smul_le g h)).op)
    rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp]
    congr 1
    apply Quiver.Hom.unop_inj
    apply Subtype.ext
    show (1 : G) * g⁻¹ = g⁻¹ * (1 : G)
    rw [one_mul, mul_one]
  act_one := by
    intro E
    show F.map (toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom (1 : G) E).op ≫
        eqToHom (show (Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)).obj ((1 : G) • E) =
          (Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)).obj E by rw [one_smul]) = 𝟙 _
    have hE1 : op (⟨(1 : G) • E⟩ : TransporterCat G X) = op (⟨E⟩ : TransporterCat G X) := by
      congr 1
      rw [one_smul]
    rw [show eqToHom (show (Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)).obj ((1 : G) • E) =
          (Cosheaf.toObject (toTransporterCat.op ⋙ F)).obj E by rw [one_smul]) =
        F.map (eqToHom hE1) from (eqToHom_map F hE1).symm]

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.toGEquivCosheafFunctor
lean_refs.signature:
noncomputable def toGEquivCosheafFunctor :
    ((TransporterCat G X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C) ⥤ GEquivCosheaf' G X C where
  obj F := Functor.toGEquivCosheaf' F
  map {F F'} α :=
    { toHom :=
        { app := fun E => α.app (op ⟨E⟩)
          naturality := fun E E' h => α.naturality _ }
      act_comm := fun g E => by
        show α.app (op ⟨E⟩) ≫ F'.map (Functor.toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g E).op =
          F.map (Functor.toGEquivCosheaf'AuxHom g E).op ≫ α.app (op ⟨g • E⟩)
        exact (α.naturality _).symm }
  map_id F := by
    apply GEquivCosheaf'.hom_ext
    apply Cosheaf'.Hom.ext
    funext E
    rfl
  map_comp α β := by
    apply GEquivCosheaf'.hom_ext
    apply Cosheaf'.Hom.ext
    funext E
    rfl
lean_refs.docstring: The inverse functor of the equivalence.

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GEquivCosheaf'.equivFunctor
lean_refs.signature:
noncomputable def GEquivCosheaf'.equivFunctor :
    GEquivCosheaf' G X C ≌ ((TransporterCat G X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ C) where
  functor := GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctorFunctor
  inverse := toGEquivCosheafFunctor
  unitIso := NatIso.ofComponents unitIsoAt (by
    intro W W' α
    apply GEquivCosheaf'.hom_ext
    apply Cosheaf'.Hom.ext
    funext E
    simp only [homNT_comp]
    show (GEquivCosheaf'.homNT α).app E ≫ 𝟙 _ =
      𝟙 _ ≫ (GEquivCosheaf'.homNT α).app E
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])
  counitIso := NatIso.ofComponents (fun F =>
    { hom := { app := fun E => 𝟙 _

                 exact counit_naturality F β }
      inv := { app := fun E => 𝟙 _

                 exact (counit_naturality F β).symm }
      hom_inv_id := by ext; simp
      inv_hom_id := by ext; simp }) (by
    intro F F' α
    ext E
    show α.app E ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ α.app E
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])

    intro W
    ext E
    show (GEquivCosheaf'.toFunctorFunctor.map (unitHom W)).app E ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.comp_id]
